annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: Whether they end up worse off isn't something I'm weighing here.
annotations.pda_responsibility: part of this traces back to my own choices
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: That protects whoever splits a job next time.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The other worker's situation doesn't come into it for me
annotations.pda_responsibility: I started cleaning without checking they were even there, which was my call.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Two losses and no gain is a poor deal

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: A process that follows through helps the next crew

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm leaving their well-being out of it either way.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I handed over the job's trust without any agreement on paper, and I did that.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: Their comfort isn't a factor, and I'm fine saying so.
annotations.pda_responsibility: That gap is partly on me.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: I could have told the organizer before I started that my partner was missing
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the organizer and other workers come out ahead

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm not considering what happens to the other person
annotations.pda_responsibility: I let the split happen loosely, so I carry some of this.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I've set that aside on purpose.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I've left it out of the question entirely.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I share the blame for how it went
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If a review would change how the organizer handles payments, it's worth $100.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: Whatever's going on with them is outside my concern here.
annotations.pda_responsibility: My part was agreeing to split pay with someone I never checked on.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: It leaves me $100 further behind and helps no one.

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm not giving any weight to how this affects them
annotations.pda_responsibility: that gave them the opening to collect
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: did all the work without flagging the no-show
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: other workers benefit from that check being in place
